Chapter 1234 - 39: Another Wonderful Use Of The Treasure Land (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 1234: Chapter 39: Another Wonderful Use of the Treasure Land (Please Subscribe)_2

Thus, progress in the spatiotemporal fusion rule has been somewhat slow.

Of course, this relative slowness is in comparison to Lin Yuan’s advancements in other areas.

For supreme Great Saints and pinnacle Peak Venerables, Lin Yuan’s progression in understanding the spatiotemporal fusion rule remains truly unmatched.

"Surpassing the Ninth Realm of time and space..."

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but feel expectant. So far, whether in the Chaos Void or in the Fang Yuan World, the limit of understanding the spatiotemporal fusion rule below the thirteenth tier is the pinnacle of the Ninth Realm.

The only exception is His Majesty the Xuanhuang.

However, His Majesty the Xuanhuang was able to take a step further in understanding the spatiotemporal fusion rule relying on his own accumulation, as well as the thirteenth-tier weapon, the Sky Void Tripod, that he acquired.

In fact, before obtaining the Sky Void Tripod, His Majesty the Xuanhuang was already at the pinnacle comprehension of the Ninth Realm of time and space. The operation of the great rules within the Sky Void Tripod merely played a supporting role; the key still lies with the Xuanhuang himself.

"Surpassing the Ninth Realm in spatiotemporal fusion rule comprehension will have profound effects on my chaos rule."

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself, as time arises from chaos, enhancing time and space is, to some extent, also enhancing chaos.

At Lin Yuan’s current level, the cultivation systems perfectly complement each other, and enhancing any aspect will benefit the others.

...

Within the treasured land.

While comprehending the source of the Fang Yuan World, Lin Yuan dispatched an avatar to begin collecting the golden mist from various places.

The golden mist is a rare treasure produced by this treasured land, dispersed in hidden areas. Even after being scoured and searched by the pinnacle Peak Venerables of various ancient countries for a millennia or two, there remains a significant portion yet undiscovered.

However, after refining all the core heavenly pillars, Lin Yuan achieved total mastery over the treasured land, making the golden mist hidden in secret spots apparent, like looking at the lines on his palm.

"These weapons and treasures..."

With a wave of his right hand, Lin Yuan brought forth a large number of spoils, left behind by the fallen pinnacle Peak Venerables of various ancient countries.

Since they were competing for the treasured land, the pinnacle Peak Venerables did not carry many treasures, but their sheer number made up for it.

Counting all the main combat bodies, over a hundred pinnacle Peak Venerables fell into Lin Yuan’s hands.

The six ancient countries vying for the treasured land only had seventy or eighty pinnacle Peak Venerables in total, but each had at least a few main combat bodies.

With over a hundred main combat bodies, even if they only carried weapons, one to two hundred pinnacle Venerable level armaments constitutes a considerable fortune.

"It’s a pity these pinnacle Peak Venerables belong to the high echelons of various ancient countries and do not allow themselves to be captured alive, so no ransom can be exchanged..." Lin Yuan shook his head privately.

Given the chance, he would prefer not to kill these pinnacle Peak Venerables’ main combat bodies; it would be better to keep them for ransom.

However, having cultivated to the pinnacle Venerable level, pride is essential. They would rather lose a main combat body and die in battle than bear the shame of defeat and capture.

Especially Fu Xu Venerate, as the Strongest Venerable... there is no precedent in the history of the six ancient countries for the Strongest Venerable being captured alive.

"Golden mist..."

Among the vast spoils, the golden mist is naturally present since it is a rare treasure produced by the treasured land; any pinnacle Peak Venerable has acquired some.

Putting away the golden mist, Lin Yuan turned his gaze to the last part of his spoils.

This was also what Lin Yuan valued the most—

The foundational weapons of the various ancient countries.

Before entering the treasured land, the top pinnacle Peak Venerables were bestowed with foundational weapons by the various ancient countries.

These foundational weapons originated from the ancestors. Although far inferior to the thirteenth-tier weapons, they require a very low activation threshold.

"The foundational weapons of the Da Fu Ancient Country..."

Lin Yuan looked slightly solemn as he examined part of them.

The foundational weapons of the Da Fu Ancient Country mainly stem from Fu Xu Venerate, who was the hope of the Da Fu Ancient Country in competing for this treasured land and carried the most potent foundational weapons.

"Da Fu Ancestor..."

Lin Yuan gazed at a wooden sword, extremely simple in appearance, yet containing an extreme sharpness. Once activated, even Lin Yuan must avoid its edge.

"Was this wooden sword carved by the Da Fu Ancestor?" Lin Yuan speculated internally; he could not pinpoint the origin of the sharp aura within the wooden sword nor its nature and felt it best not to collide with it.

"The foundational weapons of the Da Fu Ancient Country can only be activated by its strong warriors. There’s no use even if I have them."

Lin Yuan sighed; the foundational weapons of various ancient countries carry the breath of the corresponding ancestor. Except for descendants of that ancestor, other warriors cannot activate them even if they obtain them.

"Keep them to exchange for other treasures."

Lin Yuan thought for a while.

Even if these foundational weapons are useless to him, the corresponding ancient countries will certainly want to redeem them. Having their foundational weapons fall into external hands is a disgrace to the ancient countries.

Lin Yuan can definitely take the opportunity to demand some ’excessive’ conditions.

...

Two hundred years until the end of the competition for the treasured land.

According to the rules of each emergence of the treasured land, in this timeframe, pinnacle Peak Venerables of various ancient countries are usually on the brink, ready for a grand showdown at any moment.

But presently, the treasured land stands empty.

Only eleven pinnacle Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country wander about.

"The pinnacle Peak Venerables of the other five ancient countries have all withdrawn."

Red Lotus Venerable observed for a while and spoke.

"The power of the Galaxy Venerate is terrifying; he truly deserves to be called the Invincible Venerable."

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate’s tone was filled with awe. He was the previous guardian of the Hei Yu Nest, the first among many pinnacle Peak Venerables to have encountered Lin Yuan, and because of this, his shock was even greater.

Who would have thought that the young core royal back then would grow to this extent now?

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate felt quite fortunate that he did not trouble the Galaxy Venerate back then; otherwise, what now?

Though being from the same Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the Galaxy Venerate might not openly attack him, making a strong person like that unhappy would surely make life difficult.

"Indeed, the Invincible Venerable."

Other pinnacle Venerables were equally amazed.

Invincible Venerable is not a realm, but a title.

A title for the Galaxy Venerate.

Meaning unmatched among Venerables.

This title has never appeared since the inception of the Da Fu Ancient Country and the subsequent establishment of the five ancient countries.

Historically, the six ancient countries have indeed seen immensely powerful Strongest Venerables, but they could never truly be called invincible.

The word "Invincible" not only conveys extreme pressure but also embodies the despair other Strongest Venerables feel towards the Galaxy Venerate.

...

Chaos Void.

Deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, a small palm-sized cauldron floating before him.

The true self in the Fang Yuan World was comprehending the operation of its origin, while the true self in the Chaos Void was comprehending the operation of the great rules within the Sky Void Tripod.

Though Lin Yuan could not comprehend the operation of the Chaos Void Origin, a thirteenth-tier time life certainly could realize it. The great rules’ operation within the thirteenth-tier weapon, the Sky Void Tripod, undoubtedly borrowed from the Chaos Void Origin’s operation.

Comprehending the Sky Void Tripod, even if not as efficacious as directly comprehending the operation of the Chaos Void Origin, was comparably beneficial.

"Fang Yuan World, Chaos Void..." Lin Yuan meticulously studied the Sky Void Tripod while cross-referencing with the operation of the Fang Yuan World’s origin, enlightenment sparking constantly in his mind.

"The essence of time and space at different dimensions..." Lin Yuan scrutinized the Sky Void Tripod carefully, juxtaposing it with the operation of the origin of the Fang Yuan World and was inspired constantly.

"Beyond time comprehension, I am also advancing at an unprecedented pace in other rules, aided by the operation of the Fang Yuan World’s origin, complemented by Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding."

The achieved effect far exceeds one plus one is greater than two.

This is a qualitative change.

Days passed by.
